name: MGX
monetization: Abu Dhabi state-backed AI investor (Mubadala/G42-anchored, chaired by Sheikh Tahnoun bin Zayed); monetizes AI via a $49B dedicated fund spanning frontier-lab equity (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Stargate, and data-center platforms (AIP, Aligned).
description_md: MGX is an Abu Dhabi technology investment firm founded in 2024 with Mubadala and G42 as anchor backers, purpose-built to put UAE sovereign capital across the whole AI stack. On July 1, 2026 it closed MGX Fund I at $49B — above its $45B target — making it one of the largest dedicated AI investors in the world, with 14 portfolio companies since inception.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: be the sovereign check that appears in every layer of the ecosystem simultaneously. MGX is a founding Stargate LLC partner (~$7B initial contribution alongside Oracle, per press reports); a founding partner of the AI Infrastructure Partnership and part of the $40B Aligned Data Centers acquisition; and a lead/co-lead in the three largest frontier-lab rounds of H1 2026 — OpenAI's $122B round, Anthropic's Feb 2026 round, and xAI's $20B Series E. Returns are equity marks on private AI valuations plus infrastructure yield.
risk_notes_md: Concentrated exposure to unlisted AI valuations that have never traded through a downcycle; strategic dependence on US export-control policy for UAE chip access (the Stargate UAE / UAE-US campus channel). MGX positions are frequently cited in circularity analyses because its capital appears on both the lab side (OpenAI/xAI/Anthropic equity) and the infrastructure side (Stargate, Aligned) of the same compute transactions.

observations.notes: Above the $45B target; LPs across the Gulf, North America, Asia, and Europe; mandate spans semiconductors, AI infrastructure, and AI platforms.
Oracle and MGX ~$7B each vs ~$19B each from SoftBank and OpenAI in the initial $100B tranche; equity split ~40/40/20.
